title: Undo saved ratings, flags and colours that remove a photo from the active filter
source: CyberTimon/RapidRAW; adapted to RapidRoom's metadata write queue
notes: Offer Undo only after successful metadata saves. Restore through the same queue, including rated/rejected flags after ratings, and reselect only a photo visible after the saved restoration. Colour labels now share queue ordering and rollback. Toasts belong to the write that caused the filter exit, and are invalidated on folder, album or view changes.
